pairs.evidence: src/features/shared/components/forms/__tests__/NumberStepper.test.tsx:123 The test is named after the hold-to-repeat acceleration loop (window.setTimeout tick at NumberStepper.tsx:124-157), but it calls pointerDown/pointerUp back to back and never advances a timer, and the file has no fake timers; no tick ever fires, so it passes on the immediate step alone and pins neither the per-tick behaviour nor the mid-hold boundary stop (endStep) its name claims.

techniques.evidence: src/features/shared/components/forms/__tests__/NumberStepper.test.tsx:123 The name claims the accelerating-tick decision, but no timer advances, so the repeat loop is never reached; the technique says to rename such a test or make the tick reachable (fake timers).
